name: transact
title: Convex Transaction
description:
Execute Convex Lisp source as a transaction on the targeted Convex instance, signed with the locally configured account. Transactions can modify state (def, call, transfer, deploy) and cost juice on real networks.

On the default ephemeral local instance, transactions are free and signed automatically with the generated genesis account.

source.description: CVM source code to execute as a transaction, e.g. '(def x 42)'. Multiple forms are wrapped in a do block.

errorCode.description: CVM error code if the transaction failed

info.description: Additional execution metadata, e.g. juice used
